expectations.text: Identifies that PlaceBidCommand handler doesn't verify caller identity against BidderId
expectations.evidence: C-1 finding: 'PlaceBidCommand accepts BidderId from the request body. PlaceBidCommandHandler passes it directly to auction.PlaceBid() with no comparison against the JWT principal.'

expectations.text: Notes the seller-cannot-bid-on-own-auction protection in the Auction aggregate
expectations.evidence: Positive findings: 'Self-bid protection is correctly implemented at the domain level: Auction.PlaceBid: check bidderId == SellerId returns DomainErrors.Auction.CannotBidOnOwnAuction'

expectations.text: Mentions optimistic concurrency / version/xmin token in the context of race conditions
expectations.evidence: Positive findings: 'Dual optimistic concurrency tokens are in place: application-level Version property... plus the PostgreSQL xmin shadow property — both will throw ConcurrencyException on conflicting updates.'
